verdict.rationale: Kimi's API platform hosts a Mintlify API reference with a per-endpoint "Try it" runner that loads without login. It is backed by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, and a console playground turns experiments into API requests. Running calls requires an API key against production, and the docs belong to the API Open Platform rather than the assistant app. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the runner works, runnable examples without an API key, and coverage of the Admin API in the interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Mintlify-hosted API reference runs the "Try it" playground per endpoint (docs and runner load without login; executing needs an API key against the production endpoint).
